Issue:
`solveset` raises `NotImplementedError` instead of returning `ConditionSet`
Description

`solveset` raises `NotImplementedError` instead of returning `ConditionSet`
The problem is
```julia
In [10]: Eq(n*cos(n) - 3*sin(n), 0).as_set()                                                                                                                  
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
NotImplementedError
```
Here `solveset` raises `NotImplementedError` but probably a `ConditionSet` should be returned by `solveset` instead. The obvious result of `as_set()` here is
```julia
In [11]: ConditionSet(n, Eq(n*cos(n) - 3*sin(n), 0), Reals)                                                                                                   
Out[11]: {n | n ∊ ℝ ∧ n⋅cos(n) - 3⋅sin(n) = 0}
```

_Originally posted by @oscarbenjamin in https://github.com/sympy/sympy/pull/17771_

grading.explanation: Relational._eval_as_set propagates NotImplementedError when the inequality solver cannot solve a relation. Return ConditionSet over the reals with the original condition as a symbolic fallback.
